Subject: Private hosting architecture review — proposed next steps

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — good to meet you and Carlos. Quick recap and a proposed next step to keep momentum:

Summary of what we heard from your team:
- Goal: host inference in a private VPC (customer-managed) with strict data residency and audit requirements.
- Key constraints: no cross-tenant routing, private peering only, strict egress controls, and KMS-managed keys.
- Success metric: predictable tail latency < 150ms P95 for inference in your typical 512-token workloads.

Proposed agenda for the architecture review (60–75 min):
1) Introductions + roles (5 min)
2) Network & peering approach (20 min) — IP ranges, peering model, NAT/egress constraints
3) Deployment topology & instance sizing (15 min) — Dedicated pools, autoscale expectations
4) Security & keys (10 min) — KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, SOC2 artifacts
5) Implementation plan & next steps (10–15 min)

We can tailor the agenda if you want to prioritize IAM or compliance. To book the review, can you confirm which of these slots work for your team (we're in PST):
- Mon Apr 12 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Tue Apr 13 — 1:00–2:15pm PT
- Wed Apr 14 — 8:30–9:45am PT

I've attached a short pre-call checklist that highlights the artifacts that will help us run an efficient session (network layout, firewall/eip rules, KMS contacts). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1abcDEF_gDriveChecklist

If those times don't work, send a couple of alternatives and we'll adapt. We'll include one of our solutions architects and an SRE to cover the deployment and peering details.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0149

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. The agenda looks good. A couple of quick notes/questions from our side:

- Carlos (cc'd) will join from our network/security team — he'll want to review egress/IP expectations and whether we can lock down a small set of outbound IP ranges.
- Can you share any sample egress IP ranges or NAT patterns you typically recommend for private deployments? That will help Carlos validate with our firewall team ahead of the call.
- Also, we need to confirm scope for SOC2 artifacts — are you able to bring a short checklist of the compliance evidence you usually provide for Private customers?

For slots, Tue Apr 13 1:00–2:15pm PT works best for us. If possible, could we move the meeting 15 minutes earlier (12:45–2:00pm PT) — that helps with downstream calendar conflicts.

Thanks,
Elena

Answers to your questions:
- Egress IPs: for Private customers we typically provide a small set of stable egress IP ranges per deployment (not per request). I'll attach a placeholder network diagram showing where the NAT egress lives (see attached: network-diagram-placeholder.png). For the pre-call please send any existing firewall / allowed outbound CIDR lists — that speeds validation.
- SOC2/compliance: Vivek will bring a compliance checklist and our Solutions Architect (Ravi) can walk through audit-log retention and S3/KMS patterns during the call. If you need a copy of our SOC2 report in advance, we can request the redacted version via our security portal — let me know and I'll open the intake.

Pre-call ask: please share your current egress rules or a screenshot of the firewall rule that maps outbound traffic for the app subnet. That will let us prepare a recommended CIDR mapping and reduce back-and-forth during the meeting.

Thanks — Marissa
